subject: Starlight Financial - prioritization lift request (tenant audit exports + procurement timeline)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Starlight prioritization request: tenant-level audit exports + ATO timeline

Laura —

Quick ask from the Starlight deal team. Procurement just surfaced two hard gating asks for signature this quarter:

1) Tenant-level audit export (S3-compatible dump of auth/events + request trace IDs) for 90-day retention (they need a CSV export and metadata).
2) A procurement-friendly ATO checklist + evidence timeline (SOC2 artifacts + export delivery ETA).

Sophie (cc'd) says this is the last blocker for a $1.2M ARR commitment and they want a written mutual action plan by 11/17. Can Product/Eng confirm a minimal-scope implementation we can commit to? Suggested MVP: export of audit rows (JSONL/CSV) + automated retention purge job. Non-goal: retained live query UI (we can do one-off exports).

Attachments: MAP-v1.xlsx (mutual action plan draft), SOW-draft-v0.9.pdf

Asking: prioritization for an expedited 3-week timeline (can be staged). If we can get a small scoped PR and an acceptance test, Legal will take the SOW to contracts.

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Exec, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-10T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Starlight prioritization request: tenant-level audit exports + ATO timeline

Marissa — thanks for the summary and the MAP. High-level notes and a few clarifying questions before I take this to the roadmap sync: 

- The MVP you described (bulk export JSONL/CSV + retention job) sounds reasonable as a gated deliverable. Need to confirm whether Starlight requires incremental exports (delta since last export) or full exports on demand. That changes complexity by ~2x.
- We need to lock acceptance criteria: format/schema (sample row), auth method (service account + scoped role), endpoint (S3 PUT vs pre-signed), and retention enforcement SLA (how soon after retention window we purge).
- Legal will need an evidence timeline for SOC2 artifacts; I can assemble the checklist but need the target dates from you and the Starlight procurement lead.

Can you ask Sophie whether incremental deltas are required and whether they accept pre-signed S3 uploads? Also confirm whether the export must include full request/response bodies or only metadata/trace IDs.

If they accept: (A) CSV/JSONL full export via pre-signed S3 and (B) retention purge job, we can scope a narrow implementation that Engineering can take in the next sprint. Jordan/Ben — do we have a reasonable 3-week stretch to deliver a draft export + retention job plus tests if we cut the scope to metadata + trace IDs only?

I'll prepare a short acceptance criteria doc once Marissa confirms the above.

—Laura
Product Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-10T14:25:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Starlight prioritization request: tenant-level audit exports + ATO timeline

On Tue, Nov 10, 2026 at 11:03 AM laura_bennett@redwood.com wrote:
> If they accept: (A) CSV/JSONL full export via pre-signed S3 and (B) retention purge job, we can scope a narrow implementation that Engineering can take in the next sprint.

Quick feasibility from Eng:
- Metadata + trace IDs only: low complexity. We can add an export job that queries our audit table, serializes to JSONL/CSV, and uploads to a pre-signed S3 path. Estimate: 3 dev-days + 1 day infra + 1 day QA = ~5 dev-days.
- Full request/response bodies: significantly higher (data size + PII review + redaction) — add ~2-3 sprint days for data governance and validations.
- Retention purge job: straightforward (cron Lambda / background worker) — 2 dev-days and one acceptance test.
- Security: we'll need scoped service account creds and an audit of the export job (I can add that as a checklist item).

Caveats: export performance for very large tenants (100M rows) will need chunking and backpressure; for the MVP we should set a max-window (e.g., 30 days per export run).

If Product signs off on metadata-only + pre-signed S3 + 30-day chunking, Eng can target a canary in 3 weeks. We will need the MAP signed to prioritize in the sprint.

—Jordan
Eng Manager, Serving Runtime
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, Sophie Park <sophie.park@starlight.com>, Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@starlight.com>, contracts@starlight.com
Date: 2026-11-11T08:07:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Starlight prioritization request: tenant-level audit exports + ATO timeline

Laura / Jordan —

Thanks — I confirmed requirements with Sophie this morning:
- They accept metadata + trace IDs for the initial export. No request/response bodies required for Phase 1.
- Pre-signed S3 is acceptable.
- They want daily exports for the last 30 days on demand during procurement review, but can accept chunked exports (30-day windows) for larger backfills.
- Timeline: MAP asks for delivery of the MVP export + retention purge by 2026-11-30. Procurement will sign SOW within 48 hours of receiving a verification export and the ATO evidence timeline.

I've attached an updated MAP (MAP-v1.xlsx) and a working SOW draft (SOW-draft-v0.9.pdf). HubSpot deal is linked in related links.

Next steps I propose:
1) Product: finalize acceptance criteria doc (format, schema, auth, chunking rule). Laura — can you own this by 11/12 EOD?
2) Eng: if Product signs, schedule the work into the sprint (Jordan: can you reserve the 3-week stretch?)
3) CS/Sales: run a verification export to Sophie once a canary is available and capture evidence for Legal.

We need an explicit prioritization note from Product to include in the MAP (redwood to commit this as a prioritized Q4 delivery).

Marissa
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-12T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Starlight prioritization request: tenant-level audit exports + ATO timeline

All —

Okay, I reviewed Jordan's estimate and the Starlight confirmation. I'm authorizing a prioritization for a scoped MVP:
- Deliverable: metadata-only JSONL export (schema attached below), pre-signed S3 upload, 30-day chunking window, daily on-demand export for procurement, retention purge job (90d) with acceptance tests.
- Exclusions: no full request/response bodies, no live query UI.
- Acceptance criteria: sample payload (one JSON object), successful S3 PUT with scoped creds, automated purge run that deletes >95% of rows older than 90 days in staging.

I'll add the acceptance criteria to the MAP and mark Product as sponsor. Jordan: please aim to get a canary by 11/30; if Engineering sees blockers we escalate to me immediately. Marissa: once canary is ready, schedule the verification with Sophie and collect the sign-off artifact for Legal.

I'll update the MAP and send a short note to Sales leadership to mark this as prioritized for the week.

—Laura
Product Manager, Redwood Inference
